stem:
There are 6 photographs on each page of an album. One page of the album is shown.

How many photographs are on 9 pages of the album?
visual_elements: a 2 by 3 grid of photographs with 5 photos of people and 1 of a dog
difficulty_rationale: Direct multiplication of given quantity (6 photos per page) by number of pages (9). Straightforward arithmetic operation.
